args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions. Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate.
- **Identified target**: The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — status `rolled_out`.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
